# SINC CRM

> A full-stack, open-source CRM for education agencies placing students abroad. Clients chat with the sales team, sales staff move deals through a pipeline, and managers see the whole picture on a dashboard.

- Live demo: https://sinc-crm.benlester.me/ (sign in with one of the demo accounts shown on the login page; the data is fictional)
- Source code (MIT license): https://github.com/lester-01/sinc_crm
- Built by Ben Lester, a software and systems engineer: https://benlester.me
- More projects: https://projects.benlester.me

## What it does

- Three roles, each with its own screens: manager, sales and client.
- Realtime chat between clients and the sales team.
- A deal pipeline with stages, a lost-reason prompt and an append-only stage history.
- A manager dashboard, and reassigning of conversations and deals.

## How it is built

- React single-page app, hosted on Cloudflare Pages.
- Hono API running on Cloudflare Workers.
- Supabase for authentication and data.
